provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Complete index.html, sources.md and independent-check.md (plus arithmetic-check.md and director-evidence.md) read locally. No other run folder, network research, build or publication during batch39 authoring. English written from the run, zh-Hant translated from the English guide.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Strict clean-session-only research is not demonstrated: several worker fetches of the Lotte Aquarium site and some search routes used browser-backed tools whose cookie cleanliness was not exposed, and one K-ETA discovery search used a browser-request route (its result was not relied on). Hotel pages were read in a new ephemeral browser context. No credentials were intentionally used. This cannot be cured retroactively.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: Independent check passed all arithmetic with no numeric correction (budget lines, HKD conversions at 170, admission and stress cases). It raised two source-register gaps on the LOTTE HOTEL WORLD kids lounge hours and check-in/out times, and a clean-session provenance caveat. The director's later addendum closed the two register gaps from an existing readback of the same hotel page, with the register hash changing to 88ad8481…; the original reviewer has not re-reviewed that addendum. The guide follows the check: lounge hours and 15:00/11:00 are kept as the hotel's published examples.
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: No batch39 build, rendered HTML, browser or print certification. The original run's own layout tests (1440×1000 and 390×844) do not certify the new Markdown; the independent reviewer did not inspect current pixels.

datePolicy: Every source was read on 2026-11-07; the research cut-off is that date, not April 2027. Past dates (2026 bloom, 2026 festival, expired hotel packages) are separate from the 8–12 April 2027 trip dates and are not projected forward. Copy editing is not a refresh.

planningAssumptions.party: Two Hong Kong parents, one child aged 2.5, one familiar stroller; child assumed under 36 months on the trip
planningAssumptions.dates: 8–12 April 2027, Thursday to Monday, four nights, three full sightseeing days
planningAssumptions.budget: HKD 18,000 excluding flights; convention HKD 1 = KRW 170, not a live rate; FX stress at KRW 160
planningAssumptions.airport: Incheon (ICN) assumed; Gimpo would need another plan

uncertainties: 2027 adult K-ETA waiver: the temporary waiver ends 31 December 2026 and an extension is unconfirmed
Exact-date, toddler-inclusive family-room quotes for 8–12 April 2027 (taxes, breakfast, supplements, bedding, cot, early-room terms); WORLD's KRW 347,000 stay period ends 1 January 2027
A suitable installed child-seat transfer quote (KRW 140,000 each way is an allowance), or a verified step-free rail route; bus stroller and restraint handling
Lotte World Aquarium ticket, free-age and proof terms; COEX offer eligibility; museum acceptance of foreign age proof; 2027 venue calendars and reservations
Seokchon Lake current access (live page 404); 2027 bloom timing and festival controls
Allergy phrases other than the official nuts sentence are author-written and unconfirmed
Clean-session research provenance is not demonstrated (see originalResearchAccessLimitations)
editingContract: Only new data/seoul-april-toddler-trip-hong-kong-family.json, en/ and zh-Hant/ Markdown and checks/batch39-seoul-april-toddler-trip-hong-kong-family-notes.md. No shared inventory, slugs, manifest, build or check code, other guides or run folders edited; no build, network, contact or publication. Marker-only footer delegated to builder.

audience.en: Two Hong Kong parents planning four April nights in Seoul with a 2.5-year-old and a stroller, on HKD 18,000 excluding flights, with naps, entry rules and transfers to work out.
audience.zh-Hant: 兩位香港家長計畫在四月帶著 2.5 歲孩子和嬰兒車到首爾住四晚，預算 HKD 18,000（不含機票），要安排午睡、入境規定和接送。

localeReason: English and Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) both serve this Hong Kong family's decision: the parents may read either, and zh-Hant is the written form Hong Kong readers use. It changes no entry rule, price or eligibility. Simplified Chinese was not requested for this guide.
